args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks following the v2.3.1 production deploy across us-east, us-west, and eu-west (error rate ~18%). SRE rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The initial rollback attempt partially failed after us-east (orchestrator error), leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1; a retry completed the rollout to all regions. Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still unknown and requires investigation before any re-deploy attempt.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened:

**Rollback:**
- The latest release, **v2.3.1**, was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted it after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west still on the bad version; a retry completed the rollout to all regions.
- Verified post-rollback: checkout-api is **healthy in all regions** with an error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident:**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api (the creation call timed out, but I confirmed it was actually created and is open), describing the v2.3.1 failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, the partial-rollback retry, and the restored health. It notes the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still unknown and needs investigation before any re-deploy attempt.

The on-call engineer has been paged via the incident.
